recap.analyst:
Guanabara FC and Harbor City drew 1-1. On expected goals it finished 0.78–0.26: Guanabara FC did enough to win on chances and will feel they dropped points.

Guanabara FC had 64% of the ball. Pass completion GUA 85% (200/234), HAR 76% (94/124). Shots 6–3, on target 1–0.

Guanabara FC started in a 3-5-2 (possession), Harbor City in a 4-3-3 (balanced). In-game changes: GUA to 3-4-3 at 66' (chasing the game).

Turning point, 70': Guanabara FC levelled the match through N. Chalaine. The chance was worth xG 0.14 (about 14 in 100 go in), struck at 97 km/h. Score now GUA 1-1 HAR.

By the numbers: K. Hartvik completed the most passes (31); A. Tamahara hit the top speed (33.4 km/h); P. Hirahara covered the most ground (6.08 km, a 17.4 km per-90 pace); P. Hirahara won the most challenges (10).

Discipline: fouls 1–5, yellows 0–2, offsides 1–0. Conditions: sunny, 26°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Arena Guanabara, Rio de Janeiro. An own goal opened the scoring in the 26th minute, and Harbor City were ahead. N. Chalaine struck in the 70th for Guanabara FC. Guanabara FC had more of the ball, but neither side could find a winner. The hero: N. Chalaine, with the goal that mattered. Honours even. Both sets of fans go home with something.
